intent: Palingenesis Simulation room: the room's verdict line and the model's own standing counterweigh each other in the opening band; the standing instrument family shares one baseline while its three doorway figures (tier, skill, coverage) assert more scale than the two supporting figures (calibrated, parameters); hindcast and core ledger rows keep one steady rhythm, broken by a larger pause at each change of section.

roomPresence.why: Relative scale of the room title 'Simulation' against this composition's chosen baseline; 1 is that baseline.

roomSizeRef.why: Reference room-title size in rem for a 1440px instrument room; an authored coordinate for this composition, not a system token.

openingGapRef.why: Reference gap in rem between the room title and the verdict line (lede) at roomPresence = 1.

counterbalanceElasticity.why: Erik's ratified large-headline/small-gap preference (A/D, C/B ruling): the room-to-verdict gap contracts as the title grows, but only partway (|e|<1) so the room still reads as a dense instrument, not a poster.

figureOrigin.why: Shared minimum size in rem every standing figure inherits before its own role variation is applied.

figureScale.why: Shared scale in rem distributed across the standing family by variation.

primaryVariation.why: Tier, hindcast skill, and coverage carry the brief's own priority 0.8 flag: this room's three doorway figures take the full scale.

secondaryVariation.why: Calibrated date and site-parameter split carry no priority flag; they support the three doorway figures at roughly three-fifths their variation while sharing the same origin.

rowInterval.why: Base vertical rhythm in rem for one hindcast or core ledger row; both ledgers share this phrase (hc-rows / core-rows same-role relations in the brief).

phraseSame.why: Row-to-row phrase within one ledger: steady, no departure.

phraseSection.why: The boundary between runs, hindcasts, and cores is a change of task (heads-seq relation in the brief); the pause there is markedly larger so the room doesn't read as one undifferentiated list.

bandShare.why: Fraction of the opening band's 12-track width given to the verdict column; the remainder counterweighs it with the standing instrument row (lede-standing relation in the brief).

roomSize.why: Room-title size follows its authored relative presence.

openingGap.why: Counterbalance: as the room title grows more present, the gap pulling the eye down into the verdict line contracts, at the authored elasticity.

figurePrimarySize.why: Shared ancestry: tier, skill, and coverage share the family origin and scale, at full variation.

figureSecondarySize.why: Shared ancestry: calibrated date and parameter split share the same origin and scale, at reduced variation.

ledgerRowGap.why: Rhythm: the steady interval between rows inside one ledger (hindcasts, cores).

sectionGap.why: Rhythm: the larger pause authored at each change of section.

openingTrack.why: Partition: the opening band divides a 12-track row; the verdict column takes its share.

standingTrack.why: Partition: the standing instrument row takes the remaining track, counterweighing the verdict column.
